notes.en: Public preview 0.3.1. Recovers Device Inbox sends after an interrupted upload finish, clarifies delivery states and retry actions, improves spoken control names, and cleans up stale staging files. Transfers remain foreground-only. Direct APK distribution; no Google Play or Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.3.1。改进设备收件箱上传收尾中断后的恢复、投递状态和重试操作，完善控件朗读名称并清理过期暂存文件。传输仍需保持应用在前台。仅以 APK 直接分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 结算。
